answer: Epoch Handoff Ledger. Each identity must carry a signed state delta into every new epoch; if its behavioural trace drifts beyond a small distance from its own prior epochs, the delta is rejected and its rewards are forfeited to a dune of unclaimed escrow. An attacker sustaining N clones must produce N consistent histories, paying continuous maintenance and mirror reconciliation costs, while a single ember of inconsistency voids the whole cluster.
